subject.title: fix(subagents): commit superseded-run retirement before irreversible cleanup

question: Which durable ownership contract should govern superseded subagent retirement: conditional row-level fencing or a single authoritative registry writer with an independently durable completion outbox?
rationale: The required correction changes persistence ownership, recovery behavior, and delivery semantics across multiple lifecycle paths; choosing a permanent contract cannot safely be inferred from this PR’s local failure scenario.

options.title: Specify the ownership redesign first
options.body: Document and implement a durable generation/fence plus independent completion-delivery lifecycle before revisiting retirement cleanup.

options.title: Adopt a single-writer registry boundary
options.body: Make one Gateway-owned writer authoritative and route lifecycle mutations through it, with explicit restart and delivery guarantees.

options.title: Pause this branch
options.body: Keep the confirmed regression tracked separately until maintainers choose an ownership model that can be tested across writers and restart.

recommendation.title: Specify the ownership redesign first
recommendation.body: Document and implement a durable generation/fence plus independent completion-delivery lifecycle before revisiting retirement cleanup.

likelyOwner.reason: The assigned reviewer has already traced the relevant persistence, ownership, and lifecycle consumers and proposed the required redesign boundary.
